Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick walkthrough of Redwood Inference — usage triggered

Hi Lena,

I hope you’re doing well — I’m Rishi on the sales team at Redwood Inference. I noticed BrightPath’s account (lena@brightpath.ai) recently crossed our self-serve usage threshold for the "interactive generation" product over the last 72 hours. Congrats — looks like you’ve been running a few heavy prompt experiments.

Would you be open to a very short walkthrough (20–30 minutes) so I can show a couple of patterns that often reduce per-token cost and improve 99th‑percentile latency for this kind of workload? Typical agenda: 1) quick goals & current flow, 2) batching / caching tips, 3) a live run with the same prompt.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 9/28, 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Wed 9/29, 11:00–11:30

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ve cc’d Marissa (AE) to join for account questions. I can also add Monica from our CS team for architecture specifics if useful.

I attached a 1–page deck with the quick agenda and what we’d demo.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: demo-deck-quick.pdf
